subtitles_en.hook: Could you fly four astronauts to the Moon... and bring them back alive?
subtitles_en.intro: We built AstroByte: a game where your team designs a space mission, part by part.
subtitles_en.roles: Four roles. Mass, power, budget and data, in tension. If one fails, there is no launch.
subtitles_en.datos: Every part comes from real data: instruments, rockets, antennas and ground stations.
subtitles_en.launch: When the whole team approves... liftoff!
subtitles_en.room: And mission control erupts with joy.
subtitles_en.eight: The trajectory isn't a drawing: it's real physics. A figure eight around the Moon, validated with GMAT, NASA's software.
subtitles_en.moon: The cameras photograph the far side, using real lunar data.
subtitles_en.splash: And the way home: three parachutes... and splashdown in the Pacific.
subtitles_en.analysis: At the end, an analysis explains what went right, what failed and why, graded A to F.
subtitles_en.center: And you can explore the space center, ride up the tower and see the rocket on the pad.
subtitles_en.cta_h: We are Team AstroByte, for NASA Space Apps 2026. Subscribe and tell me: what mission would you design?
